title: One City’s Fight to Stop the Virus

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约

sentences.en: Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 时报》应用程序来观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: A suburb north of New York City has become one of the largest clusters of the coronavirus in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 纽约市北部的一个郊区已成为美国最大的新冠病毒聚集地之一。

sentences.en: My colleague, Sarah Maslin-Neer, went there.
sentences.zh: 我的同事萨拉·马斯林-尼尔去了那里。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, March 19.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月19日，星期四。

sentences.en: Sarah, tell us about the past few weeks in this town of New Rochelle, New York.
sentences.zh: 萨拉，给我们讲讲过去几周在纽约州新罗谢尔镇发生的事情。

sentences.en: It began with a local man.
sentences.zh: 一切始于当地的一名男子。

sentences.en: His name is Larry Garbus.
sentences.zh: 他叫拉里·加布斯。

sentences.en: He's a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 他是一名律师。

sentences.en: He's about 50, lives in New Rochelle, which is this suburb about, you know, five or so miles north of New York City's border.
sentences.zh: 他大约50岁，住在新罗谢尔，也就是纽约市边界以北大约五英里左右的郊区。

sentences.en: And he falls ill about February 27th.
sentences.zh: 他在2月27日左右病倒了。

sentences.en: And he starts to decline pretty rapidly.
sentences.zh: 他的病情开始迅速恶化。

sentences.en: He asks a neighbor to drive him to the hospital and spend several days there really spiraling.
sentences.zh: 他让邻居开车送他去医院，并在那里住了几天，病情急转直下。

sentences.en: Then on
sentences.zh: 然后，在

sentences.en: March 2nd, they find out what was wrong with Larry Garbus, and it was coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 3月2日，他们查出了拉里·加布斯的病因，是新冠病毒。

sentences.en: Cases of coronavirus are growing nationwide, and New York State is no exception.
sentences.zh: 新冠病毒病例在全国范围内不断增加，纽约州也不例外。

sentences.en: He's the first person in this suburb that is diagnosed.
sentences.zh: 他是该郊区第一个被确诊的人。

sentences.en: Investigators scrambling to retrace the patient's movements from the Bronxville Hospital, where he was first treated.
sentences.zh: 调查人员争分夺秒地追踪该患者从最初接受治疗的布朗克斯维尔医院出发的行踪。

sentences.en: And disease investigators then have to trace his movements.
sentences.zh: 疾病调查人员随后必须追踪他的行踪。

sentences.en: The week before he knew he was contagious, the married father of four traveled around the New York
sentences.zh: 在他知道自己具有传染性之前的那一周，这位育有四个孩子的已婚父亲在纽约

sentences.en: City area.
sentences.zh: 市周边地区四处走动。

sentences.en: He also attended temple services back in Westchester.
sentences.zh: 他还回威彻斯特参加了宗教仪式。

sentences.en: And found out that he had attended religious services, just as anyone would, a wedding, a bar mitzvah about a week before.
sentences.zh: 并发现他曾参加过宗教仪式，就像任何人都会做的那样，大约一周前还参加了一场婚礼和一场犹太教成人礼。

sentences.en: Synagogue Young Israel of New Rochelle ordered to close, and hundreds of people who attended services there have been told to quarantine themselves at home.
sentences.zh: 新罗谢尔的“以色列青年”犹太会堂被勒令关闭，数百名参加过那里仪式的人被告知在家自我隔离。

sentences.en: And the Westchester County Health Department ordered 100 families, congregants of that synagogue, to self-quarantine.
sentences.zh: 威彻斯特县卫生局下令该会堂的100个家庭、会众成员进行自我隔离。

sentences.en: So I'm sitting in our offices at Times Square when we hear about this diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我听到这个诊断结果时，我正坐在时代广场的办公室里。

sentences.en: And I immediately get in my car and head up to New Rochelle, because this is going to have huge ripple effects in his town.
sentences.zh: 我立刻开车前往新罗谢尔，因为这将在他的城镇产生巨大的连锁反应。

sentences.en: We know it.
sentences.zh: 我们很清楚这一点。

sentences.en: And when I arrived, people didn't even know it had happened.
sentences.zh: 当我到达时，人们甚至不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: There was a man pushing at the door of Young Israel, Mr. Garbouz's synagogue, trying to get in for evening prayers, not understanding why it was locked.
sentences.zh: 有一个人在推“以色列青年”会堂（加布斯先生的会堂）的门，试图进去做晚祷，不明白为什么门锁着。

sentences.en: There were restaurants where people should be turning up for evening hours, not understanding why their customers were calling in takeout instead.
sentences.zh: 有些餐馆本应在晚间营业，却不明白为什么顾客反而打电话来订外卖。

sentences.en: This was a town where the news that they were part of this global pandemic was just settling in.
sentences.zh: 在这个城镇里，他们是这场全球大流行病一部分的消息才刚刚传开。

sentences.en: But there's nothing we can do about it.
sentences.zh: 但我们对此无能为力。

sentences.en: I think it's another flu that's going to go away, hopefully.
sentences.zh: 我想这只是另一种会消失的流感，希望如此。

sentences.en: People were barely understanding that this had happened to them.
sentences.zh: 人们几乎不明白这件事已经发生在他们身上了。

sentences.en: And I'm still going to go out.
sentences.zh: 但我还是要出门。

sentences.en: I'm going to go to CVS, the post office, the bank, because I'm going to wash my hands.
sentences.zh: 我要去 CVS、邮局、银行，因为我会洗手。

sentences.en: I'm going to try never to ever touch my face.
sentences.zh: 我会尽量不去碰我的脸。

sentences.en: I'm going to live my life.
sentences.zh: 我要过我的生活。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: So to the degree that something is happening here in New Rochelle, it's dawning on people very slowly.
sentences.zh: 所以，在新罗谢尔发生的事情，人们意识到得非常缓慢。

sentences.en: I think it's dawning on America very slowly.
sentences.zh: 我认为美国意识到这一点也非常缓慢。

sentences.en: And New Rochelle was a reflection of the lack of seriousness with which the country was taking this threat.
sentences.zh: 而新罗谢尔反映了全国上下对这一威胁缺乏重视的态度。

sentences.en: But from that quiet first evening in New Rochelle, things rapidly began to change.
sentences.zh: 但从新罗谢尔那个安静的第一个夜晚开始，情况迅速发生了变化。

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: New Rochelle is a particular problem.
sentences.zh: 新罗谢尔是一个特殊的问题。

sentences.en: And on March 10th, something unprecedented happens.
sentences.zh: 3月10日，发生了前所未有的事情。

sentences.en: What we are going to do is focus on an area, concentric circle around this.
sentences.zh: 我们要做的就是专注于一个区域，即围绕此处的同心圆。

sentences.en: A one-mile radius containment zone is designated in New Rochelle, surrounding the neighborhood of this first patient.
sentences.zh: 新罗谢尔划定了一个一英里半径的控制区，环绕着第一位患者所在的社区。

sentences.en: Facilities within that area, schools within that area would be closed for two weeks.
sentences.zh: 该区域内的设施、学校将关闭两周。

sentences.en: We'll go in, we'll clean the schools and assess the situation.
sentences.zh: 我们会进去，清理学校并评估情况。

sentences.en: This can't be a political decision.
sentences.zh: 这不能是一个政治决定。

sentences.en: This is a public health decision.
sentences.zh: 这是一个公共卫生决定。

sentences.en: That containment zone is the red-hot center of New York's coronavirus outbreak.
sentences.zh: 那个控制区是纽约新冠疫情的重灾区。

sentences.en: We're also going to use the National Guard in the containment area.
sentences.zh: 我们还将在控制区使用国民警卫队。

sentences.en: And then in comes the National Guard.
sentences.zh: 然后国民警卫队进驻了。

sentences.en: It is a dramatic action, but it is the largest cluster in the country.
sentences.zh: 这是一个戏剧性的行动，但这是全国最大的聚集性疫情。

sentences.en: And this is literally a matter of life and death.
sentences.zh: 这确实是生死攸关的问题。

sentences.en: That's not an overly rhetorical statement.
sentences.zh: 这并非夸大其词。

sentences.en: You have people holed up in their homes, people needing testing, needing health care,
sentences.zh: 你有被困在家中的人，需要检测、需要医疗保健的人，

sentences.en: needing the basic necessities of life, and affected by this virus that dramatically curtails their movements.
sentences.zh: 需要基本生活必需品的人，并且受到这种严重限制他们行动的病毒的影响。

sentences.en: I wanted to understand, how is the government keeping us safe?
sentences.zh: 我想了解，政府是如何保障我们安全的？

sentences.en: How are the health care workers carrying out testing?
sentences.zh: 医护人员是如何进行检测的？

sentences.en: And how are the people of New Rochelle coping?
sentences.zh: 新罗谢尔的人民又是如何应对的？

sentences.en: I'm standing on Lincoln Avenue, which is just outside the containment zone in New Rochelle, where a huge truck full of hundreds of thousands of pounds of food has just arrived.
sentences.zh: 我正站在林肯大道上，就在新罗谢尔控制区外，一辆装满数十万磅食物的大卡车刚刚抵达。

sentences.en: About six uniformed members of the National Guard are standing outside this truck as a pallet is unloaded.
sentences.zh: 大约六名身穿制服的国民警卫队成员站在卡车外，看着一个托盘被卸下。

sentences.en: So, Sarah, why exactly is the National Guard there?
sentences.zh: 那么，萨拉，国民警卫队到底为什么在那里？

sentences.en: What is their official mission?
sentences.zh: 他们的官方任务是什么？

sentences.en: When I think of the National Guard being dispatched, it's usually after a natural disaster, and they are literally there to kind of pick up the pieces.
sentences.zh: 当我想到国民警卫队被派遣时，通常是在自然灾害之后，他们实际上是在那里收拾残局。

sentences.en: Yeah, these men and women had been to floods, they'd been to earthquakes, they'd been to hurricane zones.
sentences.zh: 是的，这些男女士兵曾去过洪水、地震和飓风灾区。

sentences.en: This is the first ever time they were called to an epidemic event.
sentences.zh: 这是他们有史以来第一次被召集处理流行病事件。

sentences.en: So we basically responded to all natural disasters in New York State?
sentences.zh: 所以我们基本上响应了纽约州所有的自然灾害？

sentences.en: And they were called here for two main purposes, which is to deliver meals to people bound in their homes by quarantine, and to clean.
sentences.zh: 他们被召集到这里主要有两个目的：为因隔离而困在家中的人们运送餐食，以及进行清洁工作。

sentences.en: So I've just walked into the Jewish Community Center on Wilmot Road in Scarsdale.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚走进斯卡斯代尔威尔莫特路的犹太社区中心。
zh_words: 斯卡斯代尔威尔莫特路

sentences.en: Inside, 60 members of the National Guard are doing a deep clean.
sentences.zh: 里面，60名国民警卫队成员正在进行深度清洁。

sentences.en: I watched them clean at a community center, and the meticulousness was really incredible.
sentences.zh: 我看着他们在社区中心清洁，那种一丝不苟的态度真的令人难以置信。

sentences.en: I'm currently going to inform the process of sanitizing the equipment.
sentences.zh: 我目前要告知消毒设备的流程。

sentences.en: First, you have to fit equipment and put it into the solution of water and bleach.
sentences.zh: 首先，你必须安装设备并将其放入水和漂白剂的溶液中。

sentences.en: I walk into a classroom for children, and there are these men and women squeezed in their military gear
sentences.zh: 我走进一间儿童教室，看到这些身穿军装的男女士兵挤在

sentences.en: into teeny tiny plastic seats for toddlers, pouring over piles of building blocks and Legos, and scrubbing each block by hand.
sentences.zh: 幼儿用的小塑料椅子上，翻看着成堆的积木和乐高玩具，并手工擦洗每一块积木。

sentences.en: The National Guard is scrubbing children's toys?
sentences.zh: 国民警卫队在擦洗儿童玩具？

sentences.en: Yeah, it was an uncanny sight.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是一个不可思议的景象。

sentences.en: They did this kind of thing throughout the containment zone, cleaning synagogues, city facilities, community centers,
sentences.zh: 他们在整个控制区都做了这种事，清洁犹太会堂、市政设施、社区中心，

sentences.en: scrubbing ceilings, floors, chairs, anything that a sick person may have touched.
sentences.zh: 擦洗天花板、地板、椅子，任何病人可能接触过的东西。

sentences.en: You know, Sarah, as you're describing this, the National Guard is on the ground.
sentences.zh: 你知道，萨拉，正如你所描述的，国民警卫队在现场。

sentences.en: Local officials are still theoretically in charge, right?
sentences.zh: 地方官员理论上仍然负责，对吧？

sentences.en: Like the people who run the city, probably even the county.
sentences.zh: 就像管理城市的人，甚至可能是县里的人。

sentences.en: So is it clear to you who is in charge, and is this all coordinated?
sentences.zh: 所以你清楚谁在负责吗？这一切协调一致吗？

sentences.en: In the early moments of New Rochelle coming to terms with this new reality,
sentences.zh: 在新罗谢尔开始接受这一新现实的最初时刻，

sentences.en: it was a lot of moving pieces.
sentences.zh: 有很多变动的因素。

sentences.en: It was a city in turmoil with no real leadership structure in place at that moment.
sentences.zh: 那是一个陷入混乱的城市，当时没有真正的领导结构。

sentences.en: But I get in my car, and I drive down to downtown New Rochelle to the headquarters of the Westchester County Health Department
sentences.zh: 但我开车前往新罗谢尔市中心，来到威彻斯特县卫生局总部，

sentences.en: and discover that something had been building here all along.
sentences.zh: 发现这里一直都在筹备着什么。

sentences.en: I'm standing inside the Incident Response Center in New Rochelle, and there's a group of about 30 nurses and folding chairs
sentences.zh: 我站在新罗谢尔的事件响应中心内，有一群大约30名护士坐在折叠椅上，

sentences.en: getting a briefing about their deployment to test people who are quarantined at home.
sentences.zh: 听取关于他们被部署去检测居家隔离人员的简报。

sentences.en: Make sure, go to the bathroom, wash your hands properly before you do anything, take breaks, you don't have to rush around.
sentences.zh: 确保在做任何事情之前去洗手间，正确洗手，休息一下，不必匆忙。

sentences.en: We want to make sure that you are taking care of each other.
sentences.zh: 我们希望确保你们互相照顾。

sentences.en: And there I come upon a huge, bustling Incident Command Center.
sentences.zh: 在那里，我看到了一个巨大、繁忙的事件指挥中心。

sentences.en: They're going out in groups of three in protective gear with swab kits.
sentences.zh: 他们三人一组，穿着防护装备，带着拭子套件出发。

sentences.en: The Department of Homeland Security is there.
sentences.zh: 国土安全部的人也在那里。

sentences.en: The room is filled with nurses.
sentences.zh: 房间里挤满了护士。

sentences.en: There is an assembly line of test gear and test kits and what's called PPE, personal protective equipment, that people are filing around the room,
sentences.zh: 有一条装配线，上面放着测试装备、测试套件和所谓的 PPE（个人防护装备），人们在房间里走动，

sentences.en: equipping themselves to get ready to deploy to the houses of sick people to test them for coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 装备自己，准备部署到病人家中，为他们进行新冠病毒检测。

sentences.en: And they're all asking lots of very understandable questions.
sentences.zh: 他们都在问很多非常可以理解的问题。

sentences.en: Is there going to be an influx of testing, or is it just, like, we're only doing the more shower?
sentences.zh: 检测量会增加吗？还是说我们只做更多……？

sentences.en: How do we make sure these people feel safe?
sentences.zh: 我们如何确保这些人感到安全？

sentences.en: How do we make sure that we're safe as we go out under the front lines?
sentences.zh: 我们如何确保我们在前往前线时是安全的？

sentences.en: So, at this point, in the United States, only 25,000 people had been tested for coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 所以，在这一点上，在美国，只有25,000人接受了新冠病毒检测。

sentences.en: And this command center is to send that number way up.
sentences.zh: 而这个指挥中心就是为了让这个数字大幅上升。

sentences.en: So, people will call in to their doctors, tell their symptoms, they'll get put on a list, and every so often, these groups of nurses were getting an address, information,
sentences.zh: 所以，人们会打电话给医生，说明症状，他们会被列入名单，每隔一段时间，这些护士小组就会收到地址、信息，

sentences.en: they'd put on head-to-toe protective gear and head out to sample and test those people.
sentences.zh: 他们会穿上从头到脚的防护装备，出发去对这些人进行采样和检测。

sentences.en: And there are big signs that say, we've got this.
sentences.zh: 房间里有大大的标语写着：我们能搞定。

sentences.en: The signs actually say, we've got this.
sentences.zh: 标语上确实写着：我们能搞定。

sentences.en: Handwritten signs all over the room.
sentences.zh: 房间里到处都是手写的标语。

sentences.en: And what are you thinking when you see this?
sentences.zh: 当你看到这些时，你在想什么？

sentences.en: I think I've finally found the coordinated response that this situation seems to call for.
sentences.zh: 我想我终于找到了这种情况似乎所需要的协调一致的应对措施。

sentences.en: This is a room full of all the layers of government from the state to different agencies to health care workers in their scrubs coordinating to take on this crisis head-on.
sentences.zh: 这是一个挤满了各级政府人员的房间，从州政府到各个机构，再到穿着刷手服的医护人员，他们正在协调一致，正面应对这场危机。

sentences.en: And after nearly a week of frightened townspeople and scared kids, this is exactly what you wanted to see.
sentences.zh: 在经历了近一周惊恐的市民和害怕的孩子之后，这正是你想要看到的。

sentences.en: It was a relief.
sentences.zh: 这是一种解脱。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Sarah, what happens next?
sentences.zh: 那么，萨拉，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: What else can you tell us about this containment plan?
sentences.zh: 关于这个控制计划，你还能告诉我们什么？

sentences.en: Think of it this way.
sentences.zh: 这样想吧。

sentences.en: We have 173 cases in the entire state, right?
sentences.zh: 我们整个州有173例病例，对吧？

sentences.en: We have 108 in New Rochelle.
sentences.zh: 新罗谢尔有108例。

sentences.en: At this point, things are starting to get up and running in New Rochelle.
sentences.zh: 此时，新罗谢尔的情况开始步入正轨。

sentences.en: We're about two weeks out from the first diagnosis, and the National Guard is here.
sentences.zh: 距离第一次确诊已经过去大约两周了，国民警卫队也在这里。

sentences.en: There's the Incident Command Center.
sentences.zh: 还有事件指挥中心。

sentences.en: And that command center is sending people out to do in-home testing.
sentences.zh: 那个指挥中心正在派遣人员进行上门检测。

sentences.en: But, you know, Jake, this is a microcosm of what we're going to be looking at.
sentences.zh: 但是，杰克，这是我们将要面对的情况的一个缩影。

sentences.en: The numbers are going to go up consistently because our testing is way behind the reality of what the situation is.
sentences.zh: 确诊数字会持续上升，因为我们的检测能力远远落后于实际疫情状况。

sentences.en: But still, it's not enough.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，还是不够。

sentences.en: The numbers of people tested at this point are only in the hundreds.
sentences.zh: 目前接受检测的人数仅有几百人。

sentences.en: China was doing 10,000 tests per day.
sentences.zh: 中国每天能进行一万次检测。

sentences.en: This country, in total, we've done about 5,000 tests.
sentences.zh: 而我们这个国家，总共才做了大约五千次检测。

sentences.en: So we really have to get that testing capacity up if we're going to make a difference.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我们想有所作为，就必须切实提高检测能力。

sentences.en: New York State recognizes even what they're doing there in New Rochelle, it's not enough.
sentences.zh: 纽约州也意识到，即使是他们在纽罗谢尔所做的这些，也还不够。

sentences.en: We have to ramp up testing.
sentences.zh: 我们必须加大检测力度。

sentences.en: And so how do they actually do that?
sentences.zh: 那么，他们到底是怎么做的呢？

sentences.en: Actually, they saw what was happening in South Korea, where they've created these highly effective drive-through testing centers,
sentences.zh: 实际上，他们借鉴了韩国的经验，韩国建立了高效的“得来速”式免下车检测中心，

sentences.en: managing to churn out 275,000 tests since diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 自诊断开始以来，已经成功完成了27.5万次检测。

sentences.en: And that happened actually around the same time that our country had its first case.
sentences.zh: 而这恰好发生在我们国家出现首例病例的同一时期。

sentences.en: So New York State decides we need these centers.
sentences.zh: 于是纽约州决定，我们也需要这样的中心。

sentences.en: And so I went to see this myself.
sentences.zh: 所以我亲自去看了看。

sentences.en: So I'm recording this now, standing outside the mobile drive-through testing center in a public park.
sentences.zh: 我现在正在录音，就站在公园里的移动免下车检测中心外。

sentences.en: When you get to this beautiful island park, there's seagulls wheeling overhead.
sentences.zh: 当你来到这个美丽的岛屿公园时，头顶上有海鸥盘旋。

sentences.en: There's the Long Island Sound glinting.
sentences.zh: 长岛海湾在阳光下闪烁。

sentences.en: You arrive at what looks like three beautiful wedding tents.
sentences.zh: 你到达的地方看起来像是有三个漂亮的婚礼帐篷。

sentences.en: They're tents that could be for any garden party.
sentences.zh: 它们看起来就像是为花园派对准备的帐篷。

sentences.en: And you only realize what this is because of the cop who stops you at the drawbridge to this island with his megaphone blaring.
sentences.zh: 只有当你看到警察在通往岛屿的吊桥上用扩音器大声喊话时，你才会意识到这里是什么地方。

sentences.en: Thank you for helping us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们的帮助。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: My guide was a gentleman by the name of Chuck Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 我的向导是一位名叫查克·汉密尔顿的先生。

sentences.en: He was in charge of operations at that site.
sentences.zh: 他负责该站点的运营。

sentences.en: There is three tents with six lanes.
sentences.zh: 这里有三个帐篷，共六条车道。

sentences.en: We're being directed by our National Guard personnel right now.
sentences.zh: 目前由我们的国民警卫队人员进行指挥。

sentences.en: And as we pulled up, you head down a meandering lane lined with orange cones and members of the National Guard and other police forces.
sentences.zh: 当我们开车驶入时，你会沿着一条蜿蜒的车道前行，路边摆满了橙色锥桶，站着国民警卫队队员和其他警力。

sentences.en: They'll advise us to keep our windows closed at this particular point.
sentences.zh: 他们会建议我们在此刻保持车窗关闭。

sentences.en: They demanded I put my ID on the windshield.
sentences.zh: 他们要求我把身份证件放在挡风玻璃上。

sentences.en: Windows closed up.
sentences.zh: 车窗关紧。

sentences.en: Sorry?
sentences.zh: 抱歉？

sentences.en: Put your ID's on my desk.
sentences.zh: 把你们的身份证件放在我的桌子上。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: All identification must now be put on the desk.
sentences.zh: 现在所有证件都必须放在桌子上。

sentences.en: They don't want you to open your window, hand them anything.
sentences.zh: 他们不希望你摇下车窗递给他们任何东西。

sentences.en: So groups of people in Tyvek aprons, those respirator masks, lean over, peer through your windshield,
sentences.zh: 所以，穿着泰维克防护围裙、戴着呼吸面罩的工作人员会俯身，透过挡风玻璃观察，

sentences.en: tap your name and info into a tablet, and make sure you're confirmed for your appointment at the drive-thru testing center.
sentences.zh: 将你的姓名和信息输入平板电脑，并确认你是否已在免下车检测中心预约。

sentences.en: And they're two silver dressed.
sentences.zh: 他们穿着银色的防护服。

sentences.en: These people are in full Tyvek hooded suits.
sentences.zh: 这些人穿着全套带兜帽的泰维克防护服。

sentences.en: Next, you're waived from this first zone where they check you in, called a cold zone, because there isn't a risk of contamination there, to the hot zone.
sentences.zh: 接下来，你会从第一个办理登记的区域（被称为“冷区”，因为那里没有污染风险）被引导至“热区”。

sentences.en: Yes, these are all registered nurses, paramedics or EMTs.
sentences.zh: 是的，这些人都是注册护士、护理人员或急救人员。

sentences.en: She's indicating when you keep the window closed.
sentences.zh: 她在示意保持车窗关闭。

sentences.en: In the hot zone, I was approached by two nurses in full what looked to me like hazmat suits,
sentences.zh: 在热区，两名护士向我走来，她们穿着看起来像是全套防化服的装备，

sentences.en: eyeshields, heads covered, every seal wrapped up tightly to make sure nothing could get through.
sentences.zh: 戴着护目镜，头部被遮住，每一个密封处都包裹得严严实实，确保没有任何东西能穿透。

sentences.en: I rolled down my window.
sentences.zh: 我摇下了车窗。

sentences.en: Section two.
sentences.zh: 第二区。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So there's section one and two.
sentences.zh: 所以有第一区和第二区。

sentences.en: And they told me what they would do if I were, in fact, sick, which was tip my head back,
sentences.zh: 她们告诉我，如果我真的生病了，她们会怎么做：让我向后仰头，

sentences.en: thread a swab into my nostril, and then another into the back of my throat with a tongue depressor.
sentences.zh: 用拭子伸进我的鼻孔，然后用压舌板压住舌头，再用另一个拭子伸进喉咙深处。

sentences.en: Put those swabs in vials and send those off to the lab.
sentences.zh: 把这些拭子放进小瓶里，然后送到实验室。

sentences.en: Just to lean forward and tilt your head back a little bit backwards.
sentences.zh: 请身体前倾，头稍微向后仰一点。

sentences.en: Take a deep breath and right put the swab in.
sentences.zh: 深呼吸，然后把拭子放进去。

sentences.en: And that's it.
sentences.zh: 就这样。

sentences.en: The other swab is the back of the throat.
sentences.zh: 另一个拭子是取喉咙深处的样本。

sentences.en: I rolled up my window tightly and then moved on to the next station where I was processed and a woman held up a little handwritten sign that said, feel better.
sentences.zh: 我紧紧摇上车窗，然后开往下一个站点进行处理，一位女士举着一块手写的小牌子，上面写着“祝早日康复”。

sentences.en: I imagine that everybody else going through that line needed that sign real bad.
sentences.zh: 我想，每一个经过那条车道的人都非常需要看到那个牌子。

sentences.en: So you're in total protective gear.
sentences.zh: 所以你穿着全套防护装备。

sentences.en: You're doing this work.
sentences.zh: 你在做这项工作。

sentences.en: You're on the front of the front of the front line.
sentences.zh: 你站在最前线中的最前线。

sentences.en: How do you feel?
sentences.zh: 你感觉如何？

sentences.en: I spoke to one nurse who was in that hazmat suit in the hot zone.
sentences.zh: 我和一位在热区穿着防化服的护士谈过。

sentences.en: And she appeared to me to be the age demographic that is at risk from coronavirus, which is 50 plus.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，她的年龄段正是新冠病毒的高危人群，也就是50岁以上。

sentences.en: And yet she felt this was the moment to step up.
sentences.zh: 然而她觉得这是挺身而出的时刻。

sentences.en: I feel compelled to help, compelled to help.
sentences.zh: 我觉得有义务去帮忙，有义务去帮忙。

sentences.en: And, you know, we have to be careful.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们必须小心。

sentences.en: One mistake could be a big problem, you know, obviously.
sentences.zh: 一个错误就可能导致大问题，你知道，显而易见。

sentences.en: We can become contaminated.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会被感染。

sentences.en: But this is the time.
sentences.zh: 但现在是时候了。

sentences.en: This is why we became nurses.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们成为护士的原因。

sentences.en: This is the time to help.
sentences.zh: 现在是提供帮助的时候了。

sentences.en: If we don't do this, what do we do?
sentences.zh: 如果我们不做这些，我们还能做什么？

sentences.en: If I'm not here, what am I doing?
sentences.zh: 如果我不在这里，我还能做什么？

sentences.en: What's your name?
sentences.zh: 你叫什么名字？

sentences.en: My name is Lisa Baez Alessandro.
sentences.zh: 我叫丽莎·贝兹-亚历山德罗。

sentences.en: Can you spell the last name?
sentences.zh: 能拼写一下姓氏吗？

sentences.en: B-A-E-Z.
sentences.zh: B-A-E-Z.

sentences.en: And then hyphen.
sentences.zh: 然后是连字符。

sentences.en: Yeah, hyphen.
sentences.zh: 好的，连字符。

sentences.en: And then Alessandro.
sentences.zh: 然后是亚历山德罗。

sentences.en: A-L-E-S-A-N-T.
sentences.zh: A-L-E-S-A-N-T.

sentences.en: So has this testing site been effective?
sentences.zh: 那么这个检测点有效吗？

sentences.en: Is it making a difference in containing and combating the virus?
sentences.zh: 它在遏制和对抗病毒方面起到作用了吗？

sentences.en: It is making a difference in figuring out who has this illness.
sentences.zh: 它在查明谁患有这种疾病方面确实起到了作用。

sentences.en: And a tremendous difference.
sentences.zh: 而且作用巨大。

sentences.en: They have hustled, since it opened on Friday, 2,849 people through that drive-through.
sentences.zh: 自周五开放以来，他们已经通过这个免下车点处理了2849人。

sentences.en: As of our conversation, Michael, this is charging ahead and vastly increasing New York's capacity to test these people.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，在我们交谈时，这项工作正在推进，极大地提高了纽约对这些人的检测能力。

sentences.en: This is how we're going to get a handle on this disease, to understand how it spreads, who's affected by it, to model it forward, to know what we're up againSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们控制这种疾病的方法，了解它是如何传播的，谁受到了影响，对其进行预测，从而知道我们面对的是什么。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You really can't stop it until you can measure it.
sentences.zh: 如果不去测量，你真的无法阻止它。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And you can't protect people unless you know who's got it.
sentences.zh: 而且除非你知道谁感染了，否则你无法保护人们。

sentences.en: So, Sarah, at this point, the system that you have described to handle this acute crisis in New Rochelle is a containment zone, the National Guard to keep it contained,
sentences.zh: 所以，莎拉，目前你所描述的用于处理纽罗谢尔这场急性危机的系统是一个隔离区，由国民警卫队负责维持封锁，

sentences.en: but more importantly, keep people safe, clean, fed.
sentences.zh: 但更重要的是，确保人们安全、清洁、有饭吃。

sentences.en: And now there's this mobile testing center nearby trying to figure out just how widely the virus has spread.
sentences.zh: 现在附近有了这个移动检测中心，试图弄清楚病毒传播的范围到底有多广。

sentences.en: Overall, is this starting to feel like a model for other places?
sentences.zh: 总的来说，这开始成为其他地方的模范了吗？

sentences.en: More than just feel like a model, it is the model for New York State's response.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是感觉像个模范，它就是纽约州应对疫情的模范。

sentences.en: In the coming week and weeks, more of exactly what's happening in New Rochelle is going to be set up all over the state.
sentences.zh: 在未来的一周或几周内，纽罗谢尔正在发生的事情将在全州范围内推广。

sentences.en: Nassau County, Jones Beach, which isn't too far, just got its first mobile testing center modeled off this.
sentences.zh: 拿骚县的琼斯海滩离这儿不远，刚刚也建立了第一个以这里为蓝本的移动检测中心。

sentences.en: It's coming to Staten Island in New York City, to Rockland County, another place not far away.
sentences.zh: 它即将来到纽约市的斯塔滕岛，以及离这儿不远的罗克兰县。

sentences.en: I met a man while I was out there in New Rochelle.
sentences.zh: 我在纽罗谢尔时遇到了一位男士。

sentences.en: We were standing outside a classroom where National Guard were scrubbing Legos.
sentences.zh: 我们当时站在一间教室外，国民警卫队正在那里清洗乐高积木。

sentences.en: And he said to me, you know, they talk about reinventing the wheel, but this is inventing the wheel.
sentences.zh: 他对我说，你知道，人们常说“重新发明轮子”，但这就是在发明轮子。

sentences.en: And when we look back at how to handle these things in the future, people are going to look back and say, how did they do it in New Rochelle?
sentences.zh: 当我们回顾未来如何处理这些事情时，人们会回头问，他们在纽罗谢尔是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: And he might be right.
sentences.zh: 他可能说得对。

sentences.en: The whole country might end up looking at this as a model because the whole country might be in New Rochelle's position soon.
sentences.zh: 整个国家最终可能会把这视为模范，因为整个国家可能很快就会处于纽罗谢尔的境地。

sentences.en: And this may be just what they have to go on.
sentences.zh: 而这可能正是他们所能依靠的。

sentences.en: And do you get the sense that what's happening in New Rochelle, this invention of the wheel when it comes to how to deal with a pandemic in the United States,
sentences.zh: 你是否感觉到在纽罗谢尔发生的事情，这种在美国应对大流行病时“发明轮子”的做法，

sentences.en: do you get the sense that it's working and that this is basically all on the right track?
sentences.zh: 你是否感觉到它正在奏效，并且基本上走在正确的轨道上？

sentences.en: It's hard to know.
sentences.zh: 很难说。

sentences.en: Every day there are new cases.
sentences.zh: 每天都有新的病例。

sentences.en: I don't think we'll know for a while what's working.
sentences.zh: 我想我们还需要一段时间才能知道什么才是有效的。

sentences.en: But it's deeply comforting when you look out across the nation and the world and see this patchwork of responses that barely hang together to know that here in this state,
sentences.zh: 但当你放眼全国乃至全世界，看到那些勉强拼凑起来的应对措施时，你会感到深深的慰藉，因为你知道在这个州，

sentences.en: in this city, in New Rochelle, a Herculean effort is being made to get this thing right and keep people safe.
sentences.zh: 在这个城市，在纽罗谢尔，人们正在做出巨大的努力来把事情做好，保障人们的安全。

sentences.en: I'm walking down North Avenue in New Rochelle, the same block where the synagogue at the heart of this outbreak, Young Israel of New Rochelle,
sentences.zh: 我正走在纽罗谢尔的北大道上，就在这条街的另一头，坐落着这次疫情中心的那座犹太会堂——纽罗谢尔青年以色列会堂，

sentences.en: sits closed at the other end of the street.
sentences.zh: 它现在已经关闭了。

sentences.en: You know, Sarah, we have been talking about how this town has been totally transformed in what's really just a matter of days, a couple weeks.
sentences.zh: 你知道，莎拉，我们一直在谈论这个城镇如何在短短几天、几周内发生了彻底的改变。

sentences.en: A lot of outsiders coming in, National Guard, volunteers, parachuting in to help.
sentences.zh: 很多外来者涌入，国民警卫队、志愿者，空降来提供帮助。

sentences.en: But what about the community itself, the people who are there in the city, in this containment zone?
sentences.zh: 但是社区本身呢？那些身处城市、身处这个隔离区的人们呢？

sentences.en: How are they handling this?
sentences.zh: 他们是如何应对的？

sentences.en: Michael, this is a hard time to be anyone in or out of the zone.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，对于隔离区内外的任何人来说，这都是一段艰难的时期。

sentences.en: And we are all looking for a dose of human goodness.
sentences.zh: 我们都在寻找一份人性的温暖。

sentences.en: And we were just talking outside.
sentences.zh: 我们刚才在外面谈话时还在说。

sentences.en: It's a little intimidating, huh?
sentences.zh: 有点吓人，对吧？

sentences.en: A little scary.
sentences.zh: 有点可怕。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: How do you feel about it?
sentences.zh: 你对此感觉如何？

sentences.en: Sad.
sentences.zh: 难过。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because people are dying.
sentences.zh: 因为人们正在死去。

sentences.en: But, you know, I want you to know that that's just a very few older people.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我想让你知道那只是极少数的老年人。

sentences.en: I don't want you to feel scared.
sentences.zh: 我不想让你感到害怕。

sentences.en: I'm not scared.
sentences.zh: 我不害怕。

sentences.en: You're not?
sentences.zh: 你不怕吗？

sentences.en: If you go to New Rochelle and you see people asked unimaginable things, asked to cut themselves off from everyone they love to protect everyone else,
sentences.zh: 如果你去纽罗谢尔，看到人们被要求做不可思议的事情，被要求为了保护其他人而与所有他们爱的人隔绝，

sentences.en: you see people willingly doing it.
sentences.zh: 你会看到人们心甘情愿地这样做。

sentences.en: How are you holding up?
sentences.zh: 你还好吗？

sentences.en: We've been doing a lot of deliveries, as you can see.
sentences.zh: 如你所见，我们一直在做大量的配送工作。

sentences.en: There's no one in the restaurant right now, except you and I and some staff.
sentences.zh: 现在餐厅里除了你我还有一些员工，没有其他人了。

sentences.en: People, as much as they've been put upon and wish it were otherwise, they are resolute and resilient.
sentences.zh: 人们尽管承受了压力，也希望情况能有所不同，但他们依然坚定且坚韧。

sentences.en: And they're accepting this because they know it's for a greater purpose.
sentences.zh: 他们接受这一切，因为他们知道这是为了一个更伟大的目标。

sentences.en: We just want to make sure that the stress level and the anguish that the public might be feeling, that they feel that everything that can be done is being done for their health.
sentences.zh: 我们只是想确保公众感受到的压力和痛苦，能让他们感觉到为了他们的健康，一切能做的都在做了。

sentences.en: Are you helping out, too?
sentences.zh: 你也在帮忙吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Are you going to pack any bags or give any bags hand to families?
sentences.zh: 你会打包或者把袋子递给家庭吗？

sentences.en: From the delivery people who've worked out systems to leave bags of food on a staircase and run away with a wave to the sick people indoors waiting for that meal.
sentences.zh: 从那些制定了配送方案的送货员那里，他们把食物袋放在楼梯上，挥手跑开，留给屋内等待餐食的病人。

sentences.en: What we've been doing, as I've coined the phrase, the drop and dash.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在做我称之为“放下就跑”的事情。

sentences.en: So you literally pull up to the house, you drop the bag off, and you run like the wind.
sentences.zh: 所以你开车到房子前，放下袋子，然后像风一样跑掉。

sentences.en: And that's it.
sentences.zh: 就这样。

sentences.en: Everybody gets it.
sentences.zh: 每个人都理解。

sentences.en: Everybody just wants everyone else to get better.
sentences.zh: 每个人都只希望其他人能好起来。

sentences.en: Like someone cares about them.
sentences.zh: 就像有人在关心他们一样。

sentences.en: Yes, they're quarantined.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们被隔离了。

sentences.en: It's a terrible thing.
sentences.zh: 这太糟糕了。

sentences.en: And when I pick up the phone and I see a name that I recognize, I speak to them.
sentences.zh: 当我接起电话，看到一个熟悉的名字时，我会和他们聊聊。

sentences.en: I say, how are you holding up?
sentences.zh: 我会问，你现在还好吗？

sentences.en: And they ask me the same thing.
sentences.zh: 他们也会反过来问我。

sentences.en: How are you holding up?
sentences.zh: 你还好吗？

sentences.en: And we both crack a joke and we laugh and that's it.
sentences.zh: 我们都会开个玩笑，笑一笑，就这样。

sentences.en: You know, you got to keep a sense of humor with this whole thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，面对这一切，你必须保持幽默感。

sentences.en: And it's terrible for everyone.
sentences.zh: 这对每个人来说都很糟糕。

sentences.en: It really, my heart is aching for them and they feel the same way about me.
sentences.zh: 我真的为他们感到心痛，他们对我也一样。

sentences.en: This whole thing is just bringing everyone together.
sentences.zh: 这一切正在把大家凝聚在一起。

sentences.en: Hopefully not literally because that's how Corona spreads.
sentences.zh: 希望不是字面意义上的那种“凝聚”，因为那样新冠病毒就会传播。

sentences.en: You got to laugh, huh?
sentences.zh: 你得笑一笑，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, I got to laugh.
sentences.zh: 是的，我得笑一笑。

sentences.en: Only way to get through it.
sentences.zh: 这是熬过这段时间的唯一办法。
百分之百。

sentences.en: Are you going to go out on another delivery now?
sentences.zh: 你现在还要去送货吗？

sentences.en: Um, I don't have anything at the moment.
sentences.zh: 嗯，目前还没什么要送的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是今天你需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, the United States and Canada said they would close their shared border to all but essential travel,
sentences.zh: 周三，美国和加拿大宣布将关闭两国边境，仅允许必要的人员往来，

sentences.en: becoming the latest countries to restrict border crossings, to slow the spread of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 成为最新限制边境通行以减缓疫情蔓延的国家。

sentences.en: In both our countries, we're encouraging people to stay home.
sentences.zh: 我们两国都在鼓励民众居家。

sentences.en: We're telling our citizens not to visit their neighbors if they don't absolutely have to.
sentences.zh: 我们告诉公民，除非万不得已，否则不要去拜访邻居。

sentences.en: Well, this collaborative and reciprocal measure is an extension of that prudent approach.
sentences.zh: 这项协作且互惠的措施，正是这一审慎方针的延伸。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, in Washington, the Senate approved a relief package already passed by the House that provides sick leave, unemployment benefits, free coronavirus testing,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在华盛顿，参议院批准了一项众议院已通过的救助方案，该方案提供病假工资、失业救济金、免费新冠病毒检测，

sentences.en: and food and medical aid to Americans affected by the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 以及为受疫情影响的美国人提供食品和医疗援助。

sentences.en: President Trump quickly signed the legislation into law, the first of several congressional bills related to the coronavirus that he is expected to support.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统迅速签署了该法案，使其成为法律，这也是预计他将支持的几项国会新冠疫情相关法案中的第一项。

sentences.en: The Congress has an enormous role to play in responding to this challenge, and we are determined to do that duty.
sentences.zh: 国会在应对这一挑战中发挥着巨大作用，我们决心履行这一职责。

sentences.en: In a speech from the Senate floor, Republican Majority Leader Mitch McConnell called for a bipartisan approach to the crisis.
sentences.zh: 在参议院的演讲中，共和党多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔呼吁以两党合作的方式应对这场危机。

sentences.en: This is not a challenge anyone wanted for our nation, but it is a challenge we will overcome.
sentences.zh: 这不是我们国家想要的挑战，但我们终将克服它。

sentences.en: Someday, hopefully soon, our nation will have this virus on its heels.
sentences.zh: 总有一天，希望就在不久的将来，我们的国家将彻底压制住这种病毒。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。
